# Public synthetic acceptance inputs

`sample-a.md`, `sample-b.md` and `expected.json` are complete synthetic declarations with independently transcribed expected fields and opaque bodies. `spec/rewrite-contract.test.ts` consumes both. Declaration commands are inert data.

`spec/rewrite-authority.test.ts` owns the eight literal disposition/presence cells; the unused `authority.json` copy is retired. Native authority retains external-file command context, scratch, original snapshots and reservation identity; execution uses host-account rights. `byte-names.json` and `criteria-evidence.json` retain synthetic raw-name and optional/required command declarations; actual import, byte capture and command/publication consumers own behavior. They are not separate inventory gates.

The former public inventory probe, duplicated contexts and pending outcomes are retired. The normal rewrite typecheck includes `../rewrite-port-composition.ts` once, preserving its negative type assertions.

The physical benchmark moved to `spec/benchmark/fixtures/rewrite-acceptance/baseline.mts`. Run it explicitly with `nice -n 19 npm run test:benchmark -- <new-absolute-evidence-directory>`, or omit the directory to keep evidence in a private temporary directory. It uses the same fully allocated 3 GiB file and 42,296 dependency files, validates the frozen inventory, measures first/repeat/one-edit/delete against fresh SQL/Git state, and restores source bytes after measurement. API-first is page-cache-warm; parent RSS is cumulative and JS logical I/O excludes native helper I/O. DESIGN-INPUTS 15 U3 selects these measurements for host changes, dependency upgrades and releases, outside ordinary correctness runs. Record raw timings and concurrent load without an absolute speed threshold.
